Affection and Gratitude

Participants express strong affection for the group and team, as well as gratitude for the invitation and enjoyment of the event. Key quotes include: 'I love you all', 'Like oh my god, I just I just love the team so much', and 'Yeah, thank you so much everybody. Thank you so much for inviting us. relatedStreams.title: Summary of Claims and Context
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: The drink in question is identified as green apple, not lemon, based on a memory validation. The bartender did not mention lime, and there is a specific mention of one lemon and one apple in the drink. Additionally, the drink is described as tasting of blue, apple, lime, lemon, and sugar.
